title: Artifact first, schemas second
essence: Design the reference assets to portfolio standard first, then extract the architecture from what worked. No schema before an artifact earns it.

title: The vertical slice is a blog campaign release tool
essence: Prove the system through one deep slice: a finished article in, a coordinated campaign out. The event kit is cut so the slice can go all the way down.

title: One demonstration brand; no reconstructed brands
essence: One fully designed brand slots into the system. Brand-agnosticism is proven at the package seam, not by inventing or reconstructing a second brand.

title: Code-native production is the doctrine
essence: Visual systems, composition, and validation are authored in code. AI assists interpretation; it never makes a visual decision.

title: Nine entities, three layers, no workflow engine
essence: The domain model trims to nine entities and three layers. Workflow is a state enum, not an engine.

title: The Ledger: project provenance separate from product provenance
essence: The process gets its own provenance: immutable decision records, a machine event log, kept failures, and publish flags that fail closed.

title: Substack-first format contract
essence: Formats are contracts. Every master is designed crop-proof against the publishing platform's real surfaces, with protected zones as insurance.

title: Generated imagery inside a code-owned composition
essence: Generated imagery enters as raw material only. A deterministic treatment chain owns the look; raw model output never ships.

title: One world per era; three finalists go to a render test
essence: Series coherence demands one material world per era. Candidate worlds are judged from treated renders, never from concepts.

title: Blog heroes carry no article title
essence: Heroes are visual only. The platform already renders the headline; the image does its own work.

title: The hero world is CAST
essence: Twelve rolls settle the world: soft shadows of unseen constructed forms on white plaster. Every rule in the grammar was earned by a specific failure.

title: The quote card reference is the statement register
essence: The quote card is the statement register: the words alone, set large on a wash of the article's own hero. No brand furniture.

title: Quote emphasis may be editorial
essence: Emphasis becomes a hierarchy: the source's own bold wins, a human-approved editorial span may follow, otherwise the line sets whole.

title: The in-article slot is the closing ad
essence: Restyled prose never earns an in-article slot. Every post closes with an ad instead; charts demote to a conditional form.

title: The closing ad, final form
essence: Twenty-one rounds settle the ad. Type is sized for the smallest real render, and browser-measured metrics are recorded so geometry re-renders deterministically.

title: Extraction from the frozen baseline
essence: The signed work freezes as history and the capability is re-derived beside it. Byte-identical reproduction of the signed sets is the first regression gate.

title: The brand package schema is extracted
essence: The schema is extracted from the working package and records what the system actually consumes. The four schemas written before any artifact existed retire.

title: The brand intelligence layer
essence: The brand's mind becomes versioned data: a dated strategy snapshot with its source pinned by hash, and open questions recorded instead of inferred.

title: Source emphasis wins only when structural
essence: Source emphasis wins only when it partitions the line. Micro-stress falls to human judgment; split serves antithesis, whole ink serves momentum.

title: Production integration replaces the synthetic proof
essence: The synthetic portability proof is replaced by consumption: the capability ships into a live product, while the system's repo stays the canonical home.

title: Emphasis is computed, never proposed
essence: The model stops proposing emphasis entirely; emphasis is computed from the sentence itself. The failure mode is deleted instead of the device.

title: The reliability doctrine
essence: Model choice is an engineering decision. Rejections name their evidence, failures persist their records, fixes require reproduction, and demos are preflighted.
